review.scope: Register existing Keepa envelope and result collection declarations; optional nested Product/Category/Seller/Deal properties remain open. No runtime, request, pricing, identity or publication changes.
review.official_reacquisition: The official llms-full.txt fetched on 2026-11-13 has the same SHA-256 as Services evidence.v2.json. Response sections were checked for all 13 routes, including maps, lists, optional categoryParents and both Product Search result modes.
review.regression_before: 13 operations had no typed success schema; no Keepa response sources were registered.
review.regression_after: 13 operations have typed success schemas; unchanged requests and pricing; mismatched origin/path and transformed responses reject the source.
